question: Manish alone can complete a work in 48 days and Pratap alone can complete the same work in half of the time taken by Manish. In how many days will both together complete 1/4 part of the total work?
solution:
**Given:**

Manish alone can complete a work in 48 days.

Pratap alone can complete the same work in half of the time taken by Manish.

**Formula used:**

Work done together per day = Work rate of Manish + Work rate of Pratap

**Calculations:**

Manish's work rate = (1)/(48) work/day

Pratap's work rate = (1)/(24) work/day

Work done together per day = (1)/(48) + (1)/(24) 

⇒ Work done together per day = (1)/(48) + (2)/(48) = (3)/(48) = (1)/(16) 

Time to complete 1/4 of the work = (1/4)/(1/16)

⇒ Time to complete 1/4 of the work = (1)/(4) times 16 = 4 days

**∴ The correct answer is 4 days.**
